import urllib.request, json, base64

def get(url):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer <TOKEN>"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())

base="https://api.box.com/2.0"
# gather all file ids in folder 9000
ids=[]
offset=0
while True:
    data=get(f"{base}/folders/9000/items?limit=1000&offset={offset}")
    for e in data["entries"]:
        if e["type"]=="file":
            ids.append(e["id"])
    offset+=len(data["entries"])
    if offset>=data["total_count"]:
        break
print("total files:", len(ids))
for fid in ids:
    f=get(f"{base}/files/{fid}")
    owner=f.get("owned_by",{}).get("name","")
    ca=f.get("created_at","")
    cc=f.get("comment_count",0)
    print(f"{fid}\t{owner}\t{ca}\t{cc}")
EOF
